elements.label: Chat window (Focus Session, carrying header pill and user prompt bubble)

elements.manual_reason: The status spinner/app icon left of 'Getting active' has no candidate box in the end frame; b07 marks only its earlier position before the window settled.
elements.label: Status spinner icon

pattern.description: Hard cut from the launcher (prompt submitted) into the chat window, which drifts up and settles; the agent's first status line ('Getting active...') then fades in with a left-to-right shimmer next to a spinner.
pattern.why_premium: The cut lands on motion rather than a static frame, so the hand-off from prompt to answer feels continuous; the shimmering status text signals work in progress without a generic loader, and the soft settle keeps the dark glass UI feeling physical.

build_hint.gsap: On cut: gsap.fromTo('.chat-window', {y: 60}, {y: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3.out'}); then at +0.15s gsap.fromTo('.status-icon', {opacity: 0, rotate: -90}, {opacity: 1, rotate: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out'}) and gsap.fromTo('.status-text', {opacity: 0, '--mask-x': '0%'}, {opacity: 1, '--mask-x': '100%', duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out'}), with a looping linear-gradient shimmer on the text afterwards.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}), [0, 1], [60, 0]) on the window; status icon and text delayed ~5 frames, opacity via interpolate over 8 frames with Easing.out(Easing.cubic) and a mask-image linear-gradient whose stop is driven by frame for the shimmer.

notes: Event contains a hard cut (energy spike, f672->f674) from the launcher to the chat window; the launcher is not on the end frame so it is not listed. camera.move reports tilt_down, but the background is essentially static: it is the chat window sliding up inside the frame, so no camera move is reported. b01 is a broad diff region used as the closest candidate for the window. b04 and b07 are empty in the end frame (earlier positions). Pattern could also be read as a cut-in panel settle; ai_answer_stream chosen for the agent status payoff. No SFX candidates.
